name: GeoReason-Bench
description: GeoReason-Bench evaluates models' geographic and spatial reasoning abilities. It contains items that require reasoning about locations, spatial relations, and multi-step inference in multiple-choice and open-ended formats. The benchmark emphasizes reasoning over simple retrieval, targeting multi-hop geographic/common-sense inference.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted benchmark with limited adoption, primarily used in research on spatial/geographic reasoning.
